lines.en: Enemy reinforcements from the East... more mercenaries?!  They seem determined to reach Protagonist's position.  We can cut off their advance before they reach the swamp.
lines.zh: 东边的敌军增援……又一批佣兵？！ 他们看上去是铁了心要抵达Protagonist的位置了。 我们可以在他们到达沼泽之前拦住他们。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Narima, you mentioned you were familiar with these lands.  Looks pretty treacherous...
lines.zh: 娜瑞玛，你说过你很熟悉这片地方。 看上去危机四伏……

lines.en: The winds were not kind to us, Protagonist, for this is a very inhospitable place.  There is little room to maneuver an army through the swamp, but the land on the other side of the mountains is clear.
lines.zh: Protagonist，风暴给我们制造了不小的麻烦。因为它迫使我们在这个环境恶劣的地方靠岸。 在沼泽地里，军队基本没有机动的余地，但山脉另一边是空旷的。
lines.name: 娜瑞玛

lines.en: ...  We can't let the Tidereavers get away with their slave trade.  We have a chance to stop them here.
lines.zh: …… 我们不能让噬浪团的奴隶贸易就这样进行下去。 我们有机会在这里阻止他们。

lines.en: You wish to cross through the swamp??
lines.name: 娜瑞玛

lines.en: Yes, but we will cover more ground if we split up.  Diana, can you lead a group on East side of the mountains?
lines.zh: 没错，而且分头行动可以覆盖到更大的区域。 戴安娜，你能带一队人去群山的东侧吗？

lines.en: Your judgement has not failed us thus far.  Yes, please decide who will go with me.
lines.zh: 目前为止，您的判断一直没有让我们失望过。 请决定谁将会和我一起去吧。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: These lands are not suited for the city-dwelling humans.  I am called Raskuja, and for small fee of 3000 human gold coins, Raskuja will become your guide and protector.
lines.zh: 这片土地不适合住在城里的人类。 我叫拉斯库亚，您只需要付出微不足道的3000人类金币，拉斯库亚就会成为您的向导和护卫。

lines.en: Blue-haired human has not met Barek Tor, mmm?  We become Mercenary for many of your years.  Pay once, and Raskuja slay all enemies of blue-haired human.  Raskuja is deadly killer - swift as wind, strong like mountain, strike like fire.
lines.zh: 蓝发人类没见过兽人，嗯？ 按你们的历法，我们这一族做佣兵的时间非常久了。 只需一次支付，拉斯库亚就会干掉蓝发人类的所有敌人。 拉斯库亚是致命杀手——迅捷如风，刚毅如山，强袭如火。

lines.en: Sorry, friend, our finances are a little tight at the moment...
lines.zh: 抱歉，朋友，我们的财政目前有些紧张……

lines.en: Blue-haired human is brave, perhaps foolish.  But Raskuja like this one, he hopes enemies of blue-haired human are not to be paying Raskuja first...
lines.zh: 蓝发人类真是勇敢，或许勇敢得有些愚蠢。 但拉斯库亚喜欢这样的，他希望蓝发人类的敌人不要先一步把拉斯库亚给雇过去了……

lines.en: ...You'd better be worth it, Raskuja.  Please, help us out with these damn swamps.  Blue-haired human's name is Protagonist.
lines.zh: ……你最好值这个价，拉斯库亚。 拜托了，帮我们扫荡这片该死的沼泽。 蓝发人类的名字是Protagonist。

lines.en: Protagonist is very smart human.  Raskuja worth far more than few clinks of human money.  Show Raskuja who to kill, and so he shall to be doing it.
lines.zh: Protagonist是非常聪明的人类。 拉斯库亚的价值远远超过几个人类的小铜子。 告诉拉斯库亚要杀谁，他就会照做。

lines.en: Sorry, friend, our finances are a little tight at the moment...
lines.zh: 抱歉，朋友，我们的财政目前有些紧张……

lines.en: Blue-haired human is brave, perhaps foolish.  But Raskuja like this one, he hopes enemies of blue-haired human are not to be paying Raskuja first...
lines.zh: 蓝发人类真是勇敢，或许勇敢得有些愚蠢。 但拉斯库亚喜欢这样的，他希望蓝发人类的敌人不要先一步把拉斯库亚给雇过去了……
